CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  CITY ARTS & CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION AGENDA
  Regular Meeting
  Wednesday, May 20, 2026 7:00 P.M.
  Alhambra City Hall
  111 South First Street, Alhambra, 91801
  Conference Room “A”

  I.  ROLL CALL
  Brian Canseco, President
  Susan Saunders, Vice President
  Gail Hermano, Commission Member
  Justin Love, Commission Member
  Britney Navarro, Commission Member

  II.  FLAG SALUTE

 III.  APPROVAL OF THE APRIL 15, 2026 REGULAR MEETING MINUTES

 IV.  ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS

  V.  PUBLIC ART PROPOSAL: 110 SOUTH CHAPEL AVENUE, TAG DESIGN WORKS

 VI.  STAFF REPORT

VII.  PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the public of any item not specified on the agenda. Comments must pertain to
  the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Committee. Public comments
  pertaining to the Committee’s business are welcome. Kindly limit all oral communications to
  five (5) minutes. Please complete the blue speaker card prior to the meeting and submit it to the
  Committee Secretary.

VIII.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 IX.  ADJOURNMENT
  Discussion from the Committee Members of any item(s) not specified on the agenda. Items
  discussed must pertain to the business of the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events.

 Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each type of business described herein above are on file in
 the office of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. First Street, Alhambra, and are available for public inspection
 during office hours: 7:00 A.M. to 12:00 P.M. Monday through Thursday. Should any person have a question concerning any
 of the above agenda items prior to the meeting described herein, please contact the Committee Secretary either in person or
 in the Parks & Recreation department located at City Hall or call (626) 570-5044 during regular business hours.
 Unofficial until approved by the  May 20, 2026
Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events Commission  Action Item III
  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, April 15, 2026
  7:00 P.M.
The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:02 P.M. on Wednesday April 15, 2026 in Conference Room “A” at Alhambra City Hall, 111
South First Street Alhambra, 91801.

ROLL CALL
Commission Members Present: Vice President Saunders, Commission Member Hermano, and
Commission Member Love.
Commission Members Absent: President Canseco and Commission Member Navarro.
Staff Present: Deputy Director Houghton, Recreation Supervisor Boettcher, and Clerical
Assistant II Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF THE MARCH 18, 2026 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING MINUTES
With a motion from Commission Member Love and a second from Commission Member
Hermano the March 18, 2026 minutes were approved as written.

ELECTION OF OFFICERS FOR THE 2026-2027 TERM
  • President Canseco
  • Vice President Saunders

ALHAMBRA COMMUNITY ART IDEAS
No updates from the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission.

STAFF REPORT
Deputy Director Houghton presented a rendering of the proposed 2027 Alhambra Tournament of
Roses Float and requested input before submitting the finalized rendering to the Tournament of
Roses on May 1, 2026. The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission recommended the
following revisions: include the Alhambra arch, change houses to known Alhambra businesses,
incorporate Moorish architecture, palm, eucalyptus and citrus trees instead of wildflowers,
multiple languages spelling out “Welcome!” on hearts surrounding the float, incorporate poppy
flowers, and boba, takeout boxes, dumplings, and noodles around the float.

Recreation Supervisor Boettcher shared that the Peeps and Pedals event was very successful and
enjoyed by the community. Then invited the Alhambra City Arts and Cultural Events
commission and their families to attend the Arbor Day event at Almansor Park on Tuesday April
21, 2026 and Memorial Day event at Alhambra Park on Monday May 25, 2026.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
No public communication requests received.
 COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
No committee communication.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Love and a second by Commission Member Hermano,
the April 15, 2026 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:30 P.M.
